# What this renders

A minimal Quarto project with `type: manuscript` set in `_quarto.yml`,
which writes outputs to `_manuscript/` (HTML, DOCX, JATS sidecar, and
the MECA bundle for journal submission).

One `@doi:` citation resolved automatically, and one hand-curated
entry from `references.bib`.

# Citations

The manubot pattern is described in @doi:10.1371/journal.pcbi.1007128.
The Quarto publishing stack is documented in [@quarto2024].

# What to look for

After `quarto render`:

- `_manuscript/index.html` (and `_manuscript/index.docx`, etc.) exist.
- The MECA bundle lives at `_manuscript/_manuscript.zip`.
- `references.resolved.bib` exists at the project root.
